name: Perfect Medical Health Management Limited
summary: Perfect Medical Health Management Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the provision of medical, aesthetic medical, and beauty and wellness services in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, Macau, Australia, and Singapore. It provides pain management and hair growth treatments; preventive care and fertility care services; and sleep therapy treatment services under the Goku Spa brand name. The company also offers advertising, charitable, and management services, as well as holds trademarks and rents equipment.
